title: TickShield
body:
# 🛡️ TickShield AntiCheat

### Advanced anti-cheat protection for modern Minecraft servers

TickShield is a lightweight and performance-focused anti-cheat plugin designed for Paper/Spigot 1.21+ servers.  
It helps server administrators detect unfair gameplay, reduce cheaters, and maintain a competitive and fair environment without impacting TPS.

Whether you run a survival server, minigames, PvP practice, or a large public network, TickShield provides fast and reliable cheat detection with configurable punishments and real-time staff monitoring.

---

# ✨ Features

## ⚔️ Combat Cheat Detection
Detects common PvP-related cheats including:
- KillAura
- AutoClicker
- Reach
- AimAssist
- Criticals
- Velocity / Anti-Knockback
- TriggerBot

## 🏃 Movement Detection
Advanced movement analysis to detect:
- Speed hacks
- Fly
- AirJump
- Spider
- NoFall
- Step
- Jesus
- Glide

## 🧠 Smart Detection System
- Low false-positive rate
- Configurable sensitivity
- Adaptive violation system
- Designed for legitimate players and competitive PvP

## 📊 Staff Monitoring
- Real-time alerts in chat
- Detailed violation logging
- Debug mode for advanced diagnostics
- Staff notification toggles

## ⚡ Performance Focused
- Optimized for Minecraft 1.21+
- Minimal TPS impact
- Async processing where possible
- Suitable for high player-count servers

## 🌍 Multi-language Support
Currently supported languages:
- English
- Czech

---

# 🖥️ Compatibility

| Software | Supported |
|---|---|
| Paper | ✅ |
| Purpur | ✅ |
| Spigot | ✅ |
| Folia | Planned |
| Velocity Support | Planned |

---

# ⌨️ Commands

Main command: `/tickshield`

Aliases:
`/ts`, `/ac`, `/anticheat`

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/ts help` | Show help menu |
| `/ts reload` | Reload configuration |
| `/ts status` | Display anti-cheat status |
| `/tscheck <player>` | Check player violations |
| `/tsalert` | Toggle alerts |
| `/ts debug` | Enable debug mode |
| `/ts top` | Show top violations |
| `/tskick <player>` | Kick suspicious player |
| `/tsban <player>` | Ban suspicious player |

---

# 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|---|---|
| `tickshield.admin` | Full administrative access |
| `tickshield.alerts` | Receive cheat alerts |
| `tickshield.check` | Check player violations |
| `tickshield.kick` | Kick players |
| `tickshield.ban` | Ban players |
| `tickshield.bypass` | Ignore anti-cheat checks |

---

# ⚙️ Configuration

TickShield is fully configurable:
- Detection thresholds
- Alert settings
- Punishment commands
- Bypass system
- Debug settings
- Language files

---

# 📌 Why TickShield?

✔️ Lightweight and optimized  
✔️ Modern 1.21 support  
✔️ Competitive PvP protection

✔️ Designed for both small and large servers
